pages.markdown:
Pelco Security Solutions
Pelco provides video security solutions including surveillance cameras and video management systems.
Pelco Sarix IP cameras offer HD video with analytics: motion detection, people counting, and tracking.
Pelco VideoXpert VMS integrates with existing infrastructure and supports distributed camera sites.
Pelco serves airports and government facilities. Cameras support ONVIF for interoperability.
